association_description: Encodes hepcidin, a hormone that regulates systemic iron availability and iron export; this is a biological iron-homeostasis relationship, not proof that dietary iron deficiency is caused by this gene.
Participates in iron sensing and regulation; variation can affect iron homeostasis, but the association does not establish nutritional deficiency.
Encodes ferroportin, a cellular iron exporter involved in iron transport; the association is mechanistic and not a diagnosis.
Encodes transferrin, which transports iron in blood; this function is relevant to iron physiology but does not show that low dietary iron is gene-caused.
Encodes transferrin receptor 2, involved in iron sensing and regulation of hepcidin; this is a biological pathway association, not a diagnosis.
